title: Pyramids as generators of plasma energy

tellings.quote: I do think I do think that it had something to do with the uh generation of some kind of energy. And if I had to pick an energy I would say plasma energy.

plain: The pyramids at Giza were built to generate some kind of energy, most likely plasma energy, plasma being electrically charged gas. A researcher named Randall Carlson tells Michels this as his own view ("if I had to pick an energy I would say plasma energy"), naming a man called Bob Greener in the discussion. If he is right, the pyramids would be machines, not just tombs.
